what: The India lock. Each pin is a hash of something that must not change on India's paper books during their evidence window without Madhav's recorded yes. docs/INDIA_LOCK.md explains each one; tests/test_india_lock.py checks them.
how_to_change_a_pin: Only on Madhav's decision: append an entry to that pin's history (date, approved_by starting with Madhav, a note quoting his words, the new sha256) and set the pin's sha256 to the same value. Run `python tests/test_india_lock.py` for the current hashes. From 13 Nov 2026 the repair door applies (see repair_door): a repair that changes no decision is recorded by Claude under Madhav's standing yes of that day; a change to a decision still needs his own yes for it. From 13 Nov 2026 nobody edits this file by hand: `python3 scripts/lock_door.py repair <pin> --what "..."` or `python3 scripts/lock_door.py change <pin> --what "..." --yes "his words" --when "day and time"` writes the entry (`status` shows every pin). The tool cannot tell whether a change alters a decision; the one outside check of each repair reads every entry against the commit it names.

repair_door.approved: Madhav, 13 Nov 2026 07:06 Toronto: "Yes to all" (asked: narrowing the two lock files and adding the repair door; dropping the five work freezes; one outside check per repair instead of repeat rounds). The list and the plan: claude/review-2026-11-13-the-locks-and-a-plan.md.
repair_door.what: A lock protects the decisions under test, not the file they sit in. A fault in a pinned thing is fixed the same day.
repair_door.no_decision_change: A repair that changes no decision (a crash, a wrong record, wrong words): Claude fixes it at once, appends a history entry to the pin whose note starts 'Repair, no rule change:' and quotes this yes, and tells Madhav after, in the change book and the next message.
repair_door.decision_change: A repair that changes what Ananta buys, sells or sizes: fixed now too, on Madhav's one-word yes for that repair. The record is split at that day (one record up to the fix, a clean one after) and the test's count says which sessions came before and after.
repair_door.shown_by: 'No decision changed' is shown by running the stored history through the old and the new code and getting the same trades. Until that check is built for a book, a fresh outside agent reads the change.
repair_door.not_covered: Real money, the Zerodha account (read only, no order), the sealed India years and the early looks: no repair door opens these.
